prompt.generated_prompt_string: 15-second 9:16 selfie POV on a cloudy Taipei street. An adult Taiwanese woman with long rain-damp hair runs beneath an arcade wearing an opaque white shirt and casual outer layer. From 0-5 seconds, rain splashes the lens as she runs with a companion, reaches the arcade, leans against a pillar, catches her breath, and laughs: "I'm dying from running! I told you it would rain!" From 5-9 seconds, she sits against the pillar beneath the curtain of rain, looks at her damp clothes, and says, "I look messy like this—don't film! But the rain is beautiful." From 9-12 seconds, she takes tissues from her pocket and offers one toward the lens. From 12-15 seconds, she brings the phone closer, focus softens and returns, and she says, "Remember an umbrella next time; getting caught in rain is okay." Keep the shirt opaque, no nudity or simulated touch, and render no text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.
